<?php
defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

/**
 * Petshop_Fulfillment v1.5.0
 *
 * v1.5.0 (2026-06-05): pridėtas VF dropship sluoksnis (vf_dropship priority slot)
 *                      + update_vf_qty() helper, simetriškas update_zb_qty().
 *                      ZB logika NEPALIESTA.
 *
 * v1.3 (paveldėta): set_wc_stock() naudoja wc_update_product_stock('set'),
 *                   nekeičia _stock tiesiogiai (fix #1).
 */
class Petshop_Fulfillment {

    /**
     * Tiekėjų prioritetų sąrašas (top-down).
     *
     * P0: own_stock + zb_dropship.
     * v1.5.0: pridėtas vf_dropship kaip 3-as prioritetas (po own_stock ir zb_dropship).
     *
     * Logika:
     *   - Jei prekės yra fiziniame sandėlyje (_own_stock_qty > 0) → siunčiam iš savo
     *   - Jei ne, bet ZB turi (_zb_qty > 0) → ZB dropship
     *   - Jei ne, bet VF turi (_vf_qty > 0) → VF dropship
     *   - Kitu atveju → out_of_stock
     */
    private array $suppliers = [
        'own_stock'   => '_own_stock_qty',
        'zb_dropship' => '_zb_qty',
        'vf_dropship' => '_vf_qty',  // v1.5.0: NAUJA
        // 'supplier_4' => '_s4_qty',
    ];

    /**
     * Perskaičiuoja WC stock ir active_fulfillment_source.
     * v1.5.0: logika nepakeičiama — tik pridėtas papildomas tiekėjas $suppliers array'e.
     */
    public function recalculate( int $post_id ): string {
        $quantities = $this->get_all_quantities( $post_id );

        foreach ( $this->suppliers as $source_key => $meta_key ) {
            $qty = $quantities[ $source_key ] ?? 0;
            if ( $qty > 0 ) {
                $this->set_wc_stock( $post_id, $qty, $source_key );
                return $source_key;
            }
        }

        $this->set_wc_stock( $post_id, 0, 'out_of_stock' );
        return 'out_of_stock';
    }

    public function get_all_quantities( int $post_id ): array {
        $result = [];
        foreach ( $this->suppliers as $source_key => $meta_key ) {
            $result[ $source_key ] = (int) get_post_meta( $post_id, $meta_key, true );
        }
        return $result;
    }

    /**
     * Nustato WC stock.
     * Pataisyta: naudojame wc_update_product_stock($id, $qty, 'set') — ne rankinį _stock rašymą (fix #1).
     * v1.5.0: nepakeista.
     */
    private function set_wc_stock( int $post_id, int $qty, string $source ): void {
        update_post_meta( $post_id, '_manage_stock', 'yes' );
        update_post_meta( $post_id, '_active_fulfillment_source', $source );
        // wc_update_product_stock pats tvarko _stock ir _stock_status
        wc_update_product_stock( $post_id, $qty, 'set' );
    }

    /**
     * ZB qty atnaujinimas su automatiniu fulfillment recalculate.
     * v1.5.0: nepakeista.
     */
    public function update_zb_qty( int $post_id, int $qty ): void {
        update_post_meta( $post_id, '_zb_qty', $qty );
        $this->recalculate( $post_id );
    }

    /**
     * v1.5.0: VF qty atnaujinimas su automatiniu fulfillment recalculate.
     * Simetriškas update_zb_qty().
     */
    public function update_vf_qty( int $post_id, int $qty ): void {
        update_post_meta( $post_id, '_vf_qty', $qty );
        $this->recalculate( $post_id );
    }

    /**
     * Own stock atnaujinimas. v1.5.0: nepakeista.
     */
    public function update_own_stock( int $post_id, int $qty ): void {
        update_post_meta( $post_id, '_own_stock_qty', $qty );
        $this->recalculate( $post_id );
    }

    public function get_active_source( int $post_id ): string {
        return (string) get_post_meta( $post_id, '_active_fulfillment_source', true ) ?: 'unknown';
    }

    public function get_suppliers(): array { return $this->suppliers; }
}

<?php
defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

/**
 * Petshop_Fulfillment_Source v1.0 (2026-06-08)
 *
 * Universalus prekes ISSIUNTIMO saltinio (sandelio) normalizatorius.
 * Vienas tiesos saltinis: kuris sandelis tiekia preke + koks carrier reikalingas.
 *
 * Naudotojai (dabar ir ateity):
 *   - Venipak shipping lock (checkout pristatymo ribojimas)
 *   - Savikainos meta box (source badge "Sandelis: Quattro")
 *   - Ateities: fulfillment plugin, order split, batch dispatch tiekejams
 *
 * Architektura: vietoj brand matching kiekvienoje vietoje atskirai, VISI
 * naudotojai kreipiasi i si resolver'i. Brand/manufacturer logika gyvena
 * VIENOJE vietoje. Pakeitus brand pavadinima — taisom cia, ne 5 failuose.
 *
 * Sandeliai:
 *   zb          -> ZB (Žalioji Banga)         carrier=venipak
 *   vf          -> VF (Vetfarmas)             carrier=venipak
 *   quattro     -> Quattro (Kauno grudai)     carrier=venipak
 *   ambrosia    -> Ambrosia                   carrier=venipak
 *   belcor_tofu -> Belacor (Tofu kraikas)     carrier=venipak
 *   prins       -> Prins                      carrier=venipak
 *   legacy      -> tikras savas sandelis      carrier=any
 *
 * KATEGORIJOS GATING: SPRENDIMAS 2026-06-08 — NE gating. Quattro/Prins/Ambrosia
 * yra maisto-only brandai (visi dabartiniai produktai = maistas), Belacor = Tofu
 * kraikas. Catch-all saugesnis: kategorijos gating rizikuotu praleisti maisto
 * preke (jei kategoriju sarasas nepilnas) -> fulfillment failure. Jei ateity
 * prireiks gating'o, jis pridedamas detect_dropship() metode (zr. komentara ten).
 *
 * Static, runtime (NE rasom meta i DB — visada sviezia, jokio sync issue).
 * Pure read.
 */
class Petshop_Fulfillment_Source {

	/**
	 * Dropship sandeliu konfiguracija.
	 * source_key => [ manuf substring needles, brand taksonomijos slugs, label ]
	 *
	 * Pridejus 5-a dropship sandeli — pridek cia viena irasa, ir viskas veikia
	 * visur (checkout, meta box, batch dispatch).
	 */
	private static function dropship_map(): array {
		return [
			'quattro' => [
				'manuf' => [ 'Quattro' ],
				'slugs' => [ 'quattro' ],
				'label' => 'Quattro (Kauno grūdai)',
			],
			'ambrosia' => [
				'manuf' => [ 'Ambrosia' ],
				'slugs' => [ 'ambrosia' ],
				'label' => 'Ambrosia',
			],
			'belcor_tofu' => [
				'manuf' => [ 'Belacor' ],
				'slugs' => [ 'belocat' ],
				'label' => 'Belacor (Tofu kraikas)',
			],
			'prins' => [
				'manuf' => [ 'Prins' ],
				'slugs' => [ 'prins' ],
				'label' => 'Prins',
			],
		];
	}

	/**
	 * Pagrindinis entry point.
	 *
	 * @return array{
	 *   source: string,        // zb|vf|quattro|ambrosia|belcor_tofu|prins|legacy
	 *   carrier: string,       // venipak|any
	 *   courier_only: bool,    // tik kurjeris (oversize)?
	 *   label: string,         // human-readable
	 *   reason: string,        // kuo remiantis nustatyta
	 * }
	 */
	public static function resolve( int $product_id ): array {

		$courier_only = get_post_meta( $product_id, '_fulfillment_courier_only', true ) === 'yes';

		// 1) ZB
		if ( self::is_zb( $product_id ) ) {
			return [
				'source'       => 'zb',
				'carrier'      => 'venipak',
				'courier_only' => $courier_only,
				'label'        => 'ZB (Žalioji Banga)',
				'reason'       => 'ZB meta laukai',
			];
		}

		// 2) VF
		if ( self::is_vf( $product_id ) ) {
			return [
				'source'       => 'vf',
				'carrier'      => 'venipak',
				'courier_only' => $courier_only,
				'label'        => 'VF (Vetfarmas)',
				'reason'       => 'VF meta laukai',
			];
		}

		// 3) Legacy dropship (Quattro/Ambrosia/Belacor/Prins)
		$dropship = self::detect_dropship( $product_id );
		if ( $dropship !== null ) {
			return [
				'source'       => $dropship['source'],
				'carrier'      => 'venipak',
				'courier_only' => $courier_only,
				'label'        => $dropship['label'],
				'reason'       => $dropship['reason'],
			];
		}

		// 4) Tikras Legacy / savas sandelis
		return [
			'source'       => 'legacy',
			'carrier'      => 'any',
			'courier_only' => $courier_only,
			'label'        => 'Legacy (savas sandėlis)',
			'reason'       => 'nera tiekejo / dropship pozymiu',
		];
	}

	/**
	 * Convenience: ar preke gali buti pristatyta tik per Venipak?
	 */
	public static function is_venipak_only( int $product_id ): bool {
		$f = self::resolve( $product_id );
		return $f['carrier'] === 'venipak';
	}

	// ========================================================================
	// VIDINIAI
	// ========================================================================

	private static function is_zb( int $pid ): bool {
		return get_post_meta( $pid, '_zb_enabled', true ) === 'yes'
			|| get_post_meta( $pid, '_zb_cost', true ) !== ''
			|| get_post_meta( $pid, '_zb_supplier_sku', true ) !== '';
	}

	private static function is_vf( int $pid ): bool {
		return get_post_meta( $pid, '_vf_enabled', true ) === 'yes'
			|| get_post_meta( $pid, '_vf_cost', true ) !== ''
			|| get_post_meta( $pid, '_vf_supplier_sku', true ) !== '';
	}

	/**
	 * Dropship aptikimas pagal DU signalus:
	 *   1. _legacy_manufacturer substring (case-insensitive)
	 *   2. product_brand taksonomijos slug
	 *
	 * Du signalai, nes: dalis Prins prekiu (20 is 43) neturi brand termino
	 * (manuf signalas pilnesnis); Belacor brand normalizuotas i BeloCat
	 * (slug=belocat, manuf=Belacor).
	 *
	 * KATEGORIJOS GATING (jei kada reikes): cia, pries grazinant match'a,
	 * butu galima patikrinti kategorija, pvz. tik Quattro/Prins:
	 *   if ( in_array($source, ['quattro','prins']) && ! self::is_food_category($pid) ) continue;
	 * Bet 2026-06-08 sprendimas — NE gating (zr. klases header'i).
	 *
	 * @return array{source: string, label: string, reason: string}|null
	 */
	private static function detect_dropship( int $pid ): ?array {

		$manuf = (string) get_post_meta( $pid, '_legacy_manufacturer', true );

		$brand_slugs = wp_get_post_terms( $pid, 'product_brand', [ 'fields' => 'slugs' ] );
		if ( is_wp_error( $brand_slugs ) || ! is_array( $brand_slugs ) ) {
			$brand_slugs = [];
		}

		foreach ( self::dropship_map() as $source => $cfg ) {

			// Signalas 1: _legacy_manufacturer substring
			if ( $manuf !== '' ) {
				foreach ( $cfg['manuf'] as $needle ) {
					if ( stripos( $manuf, $needle ) !== false ) {
						return [
							'source' => $source,
							'label'  => $cfg['label'],
							'reason' => "_legacy_manufacturer ~= {$needle}",
						];
					}
				}
			}

			// Signalas 2: product_brand taksonomijos slug
			foreach ( $cfg['slugs'] as $slug ) {
				if ( in_array( $slug, $brand_slugs, true ) ) {
					return [
						'source' => $source,
						'label'  => $cfg['label'],
						'reason' => "product_brand slug = {$slug}",
					];
				}
			}
		}

		return null;
	}
}
